root_cause: Bug 1863140 Part 3 (commit 321172222a2e) refactored FinalizationRegistry.register/unregister to support non-object (e.g. symbol) targets/unregister tokens via a new CanBeHeldWeakly() helper. While doing so, the unregister() function's existing safe pattern of `args.get(0).isObject()` followed by `&args[0].toObject()` (indexing only after confirming the argument existed and was an object) was replaced by directly constructing `RootedValue unregisterToken(cx, args[0])` ahead of any validation, re-introducing an unchecked array index into the native call arguments before verifying argc covers that index.
